description:
# PR Comment

## Summary
- stabilize coverage runs and reduce brittle failures
- update template rendering to current Jinja/Starlette APIs
- align log search models and query validation with Pydantic/FastAPI updates
- reduce warning noise and cleanup edge-case logging

## Details
- switch template rendering to preconfigured Jinja environment and new TemplateResponse signature
- update SQLAlchemy event listener signature and psutil connection API usage
- tighten tests around deprecated paths and SQLAlchemy boolean clauses
